name: What can go wrong with crown molding installation?
description: Bad cuts, gaps, and uneven joints are the biggest issues, especially in rooms with crooked walls or ceilings.

mainEntity.name: What can go wrong with crown molding installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The main risks are visible gaps, poor corner joints, cracks from movement, and a finish that doesn’t match the rest of the room. These problems are more common when the walls or ceilings are uneven, so careful measuring, proper fastening, and quality caulking matter a lot.
